annotations.title: Connect Your Account by Signing In

description: Connect YOUR OWN account by signing in with its email or phone and password. When the account asks for a two-factor code, an emailed code or a check a person must finish, the answer carries a `challenge_id` (and a `handoff_url` for a check): call again with `code` and `challenge_id` within 15 minutes. With `totp_secret` (the authenticator setup key) the two-factor code is typed for you; `remember: true` keeps the details encrypted so a later sign-out is signed back in automatically. Free. A password is a credential: pass it only when the user gives it. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

account_id.description: Which connected account (accounts_list). Optional while this key has exactly one.

challenge_id.description: The challenge_id from the previous answer.

code.description: The two-factor or emailed code, on a resumed sign-in.

identifier.description: The account's sign-in email or phone.

password.description: The account's password; kept encrypted only when remember is true.

proxy_url.description: Optional: your own http, https or socks5 proxy for this account.

remember.description: Optional opt-in: keep the sign-in details encrypted for automatic re-login after a sign-out. Deleted on disconnect.

totp_secret.description: Optional: the authenticator app's setup key (base32), so the two-factor code is typed for you.

user_agent.description: Optional: the browser user agent to sign in with.

name: account_login
